IdColumnDropper.source:
from typing import Sequence
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.base import TransformerMixin

from factory.operators.base import Operator, OperatorMeta
from factory.schemas import OperatorKind


class IdColumnDropper(TransformerMixin, Operator):
    meta = OperatorMeta(
        name="IdColumnDropper",
        kind=OperatorKind.FEATURE,
        version=2,
        origin="synthesized",
        description="移除客户ID等无业务预测意义的标识列，防止编码维度暴涨和过拟合",
        conditions=["id_columns"],
        dependencies=[],
        params={"id_cols": ("customer_id",)},
        parent="IdColumnDropper@1",
    )

    def __init__(self, id_cols: Sequence[str] = ("customer_id",)):
        self.id_cols = id_cols

    def fit(self, X: pd.DataFrame, y=None):
        cols_to_check = set(self.id_cols) if self.id_cols is not None else set()
        self.drop_cols_ = [col for col in X.columns if col in cols_to_check]
        return self

    def transform(self, X: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        X = X.copy()
        cols_to_drop = [c for c in self.drop_cols_ if c in X.columns]
        if cols_to_drop:
            X = X.drop(columns=cols_to_drop)
        return X

BalancedLightGBMClassifier.source:
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.base import ClassifierMixin
from factory.operators.base import Operator, OperatorMeta
from factory.schemas import OperatorKind, Modality


class BalancedLightGBMClassifier(ClassifierMixin, Operator):
    meta = OperatorMeta(
        name="BalancedLightGBMClassifier",
        kind=OperatorKind.MODEL,
        version=2,
        origin="synthesized",
        description="基于LightGBM的平衡分类器，支持正负样本权重自动平衡与特征重要性输出",
        conditions=["imbalanced", "classification", "tabular"],
        dependencies=["lightgbm", "scikit-learn"],
        params={
            "n_estimators": 400,
            "learning_rate": 0.05,
            "num_leaves": 31,
            "max_depth": -1,
            "class_weight": "balanced",
            "subsample": 0.8,
            "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
            "random_state": 42,
            "verbose": -1,
        },
        parent="BalancedLightGBMClassifier@1",
    )

    def __init__(
        self,
        n_estimators=400,
        learning_rate=0.05,
        num_leaves=31,
        max_depth=-1,
        class_weight="balanced",
        subsample=0.8,
        colsample_bytree=0.8,
        random_state=42,
        verbose=-1,
    ):
        self.n_estimators = n_estimators
        self.learning_rate = learning_rate
        self.num_leaves = num_leaves
        self.max_depth = max_depth
        self.class_weight = class_weight
        self.subsample = subsample
        self.colsample_bytree = colsample_bytree
        self.random_state = random_state
        self.verbose = verbose

    def fit(self, X, y):
        X_df = pd.DataFrame(X).copy()
        y_arr = np.asarray(y)

        self.classes_ = np.unique(y_arr)
        self.feature_names_in_ = np.array(X_df.columns, dtype=str)
        self.n_features_in_ = X_df.shape[1]

        # 确保列名无特殊 JSON 字符干扰 LightGBM
        clean_cols = [str(c).replace(":", "_").replace(" ", "_") for c in X_df.columns]
        X_df.columns = clean_cols
        self.cleaned_feature_names_ = clean_cols

        self.model_ = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
            n_estimators=self.n_estimators,
            learning_rate=self.learning_rate,
            num_leaves=self.num_leaves,
            max_depth=self.max_depth,
            class_weight=self.class_weight,
            subsample=self.subsample,
            colsample_bytree=self.colsample_bytree,
            random_state=self.random_state,
            verbose=self.verbose,
        )

        self.model_.fit(X_df, y_arr)
        self.feature_importances_ = self.model_.feature_importances_
        return self

    def _prepare_input(self, X):
        X_df = pd.DataFrame(X).copy()
        if hasattr(self, "cleaned_feature_names_"):
            X_df.columns = self.cleaned_feature_names_
        return X_df

    def predict_proba(self, X):
        X_df = self._prepare_input(X)
        proba = self.model_.predict_proba(X_df)
        return np.asarray(proba, dtype=np.float64)

    def predict(self, X):
        X_df = self._prepare_input(X)
        pred = self.model_.predict(X_df)
        return np.asarray(pred)

lessons.title: 数值列含空白字符导致类型转换失败
lessons.trigger: 新入网客户累计消费为空白字符串，读取为 object 类型，转 float 时抛出 ValueError: could not convert string to float: ' '
lessons.fix: 先 str.strip()，再 pd.to_numeric(errors='coerce')，缺失值填补为 0

lessons.title: 样本不平衡导致默认模型召回率偏低
lessons.trigger: 流失场景存在正负样本不平衡，模型默认阈值或未配置样本权重时召回率达不到业务要求
lessons.fix: 启用平衡类权重（如 class_weight='balanced' 或 BalancedLightGBMClassifier）以提升召回率

lessons.title: 逻辑回归标准化与可解释性
lessons.trigger: 使用逻辑回归模型，或者需要模型具有高可解释性时
lessons.fix: 必须先进行特征标准化（如 StandardFeatureScaler），在 0.1~10 之间搜索正则化强度 C，可直接输出系数给业务方。

lessons.title: 未剔除客户 ID 导致 One-Hot 编码后维度暴涨与内存溢出
lessons.trigger: customer_id 等标识列未剔除，直接进行 One-Hot 编码导致特征维度暴涨并引发内存溢出
lessons.fix: 建模前剔除 ID 等标识列，并在编码器中设置最大类别数

lessons.title: 预测阶段出现未见类别导致编码报错
lessons.trigger: 线上/测试集出现未见类别，OneHotEncoder 抛出 ValueError: Found unknown categories
lessons.fix: 编码器配置 handle_unknown='ignore' 或 infrequent_if_exist 忽略未知类别
